2dbe865b91eb.text: Dad? ...I heard a bang. Are you okay? Do the thing from the manual. Dad, I know it by heart.

917ee09e4308.text: Bus side first. Then the line side. The breaker last. Never touch the bypass. Never switch a disconnect under load.

d8aa2a5bbaa3.text: Dad! Dad, the school just lit up. The gym, the hall, everything. Gran's shelter is there.

2d2fc6846ace.text: People are crying. Gran's saying your name. Please hurry. Please, before they come toward the light.

847e547a41e5.text: ...Dad? You're LATE. You said Tuesday. It's been three days.

028b619a0d9c.text: School. Gran's shelter. It's so cold, the power's been out since the storm and there are people who sleep and don't...

6061bcae4f7c.text: Don't use your light. They see it. They come to the light, Dad. Dad, I can hear the hum again, it sounds like

064b80222c88.text: Dad? The school lights just came on. Gran ran the warming shelter there. Check the gym.

df4a4e48555c.text: I don't stay anywhere. You'd know that if you ever called.

06fb17479226.text: Kade? Elias Kade?! Get out of here, kid — don't look at the light!

0a749afbb8cb.text: He's got my — he's SAYING MY NAME — tell Ruth I kept the —

5d03efe338c5.text: Dad, I heard someone shouting on the open channel. Was that you? Are you okay?

ace0ea6c6aa2.text: Keep moving. Church first, Dad. The hum's loud, I can't stay on. I'll check in.

9d7e68311a5f.text: Dad? ...Dad, I can hear bells. Are you at the church? Please say yes.

5a4c02789dc4.text: I followed her. I know, I know. She just kept walking toward the lake like she wasn't cold.

ae03ccb64732.text: There's a pipe from the data center going down into the mine. Gran went in through Meridian.

2bc46ca4f6de.text: You said that about Christmas, too. ...Just hurry.

b81efbaa6df8.text: ...Dad? ...so cold. I can hear a... bell. Is that... you?

3fb089440ba3.text: ...Dad? Dad, is that you? Or are you the other one?

931fbb68b510.text: Three years, Dad. Three Christmases. And you pick tonight to drive up?

2bec7b73c236.text: I almost didn't pick up. When you called on the radio. I almost didn't.

d48fa6540fef.text: My feet are gone. I'll walk anyway. Don't carry me, I'm not five.

f555f039f8ce.text: Gran went deeper. She heard Grandpa in the hum, and she went down the brine shaft.

0a5c9590a152.text: She's not Gran anymore, Dad. She's singing.

441b92aa16ce.text: Eli... come down. It's warm down here. Your father's here.

b5ed67177a72.text: Don't. Dad, don't answer her. That's what she does.

30b7525e8da3.text: Dad? I heard it stop. I'm... in the refuge. Steel door, north. The big cold room. Please hurry.

8d7b3f986144.text: Nineteen hertz. I measured it on Gran's old scope. It makes people hear things, Dad.

f01c3170adf5.text: I keep hearing Mom laughing in the kitchen. She's in Arizona.

5d802b851509.text: Somebody lit this on purpose. Someone was still thinking down here.

752a6b8d7e06.text: Gran's down there. I can feel it. Is that stupid? It feels like being looked at.

a17e2bcbc990.text: She's gone, isn't she. The hum stopped.

bc3d687785ed.text: Then that's what's left. The control station, by the east wall.

d89709e12fa8.text: Two handles. That's it? After all this, it's two handles.

937347145893.text: Gran's still in there, Dad. Whatever's left. And Grandpa's voice. Even if it was never him.

eb3937a5c462.text: If you burn it, it's over. Corvane calls it a mining accident. Nobody ever pays for any of it.

c12fa78d7bd0.text: If you cut it, it sleeps. It doesn't die. Someday somebody turns the heat back on and it wakes up.

7b68598679f7.text: No. I used to think grown-ups just knew which one was right.

34f013171dfb.text: Pick the one you can live with, and I'll stand next to you. I'm not leaving this time.
